verdict.rationale: The open-source framework follows Semantic Versioning, marks deprecated APIs in explicit changelog sections with removal targets (e.g. "will be removed in 2.0.0"), and has a dedicated 1.0 migration guide, so its versioning and deprecation discipline is documented. The Pipecat Cloud REST API, however, is versioned only by its URL path (/v1) and has no documented deprecation window. missing for 10: a standalone formal deprecation policy with stated timelines, a deprecation/sunset policy for the Cloud REST API, independent corroboration of how reliably the policy is followed

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: this project adheres to Semantic Versioning
Pipecat 1.0 removes many deprecated APIs from the 0.0.x series. If you were already using the non-deprecated replacements, most of these changes won't affect you.
Deprecations are staged in the changelog before removal at the major version.
